K_lock_criteria.directional_secondary: eta_E and zeta_E each within 20% in >=80% of trials; reported only after K-lock passes
K_lock_criteria.model_specificity: full reciprocal model wins >=80% of leave-one-perturbation-family-out CV folds
K_lock_criteria.primary_pass: >= 90% of trials recover K within 15% of K_true AND median K error <= 10%

alternative_models.description: eta_E and zeta_E free; K primary.
alternative_models.name: full_reciprocal

alternative_models.description: Y-to-E direction only; zeta_E fixed to zero.
alternative_models.name: eta_only

alternative_models.description: E-to-Y direction only; eta_E fixed to zero.
alternative_models.name: zeta_only

alternative_models.description: independent non-directional stimulus-basis regression; no reciprocal loop.
alternative_models.name: replay_only_basis

alternative_models.description: single symmetric hidden oscillator parameter h; no eta/zeta decomposition.
alternative_models.name: generic_hidden_oscillator

boundary: Synthetic Rung 0 only. This does not prove OSM, microtubular memory, LTP, dendritic spine growth, quantum memory, or human EEG mechanism.

failure_thresholds.K_lock_failure: <90% trials within 15% K error OR median K error >10%
failure_thresholds.alternative_warning: any single non-full alternative wins >20% of held-out CV folds
failure_thresholds.ridge_warning: profile likelihood remains broad enough that eta/zeta separation is conditional even if K-lock passes
failure_thresholds.specificity_failure: full reciprocal held-out CV win rate <80%

fresh_seed_policy.rule: No tuning, no grid change, no perturbation change, and no threshold change after seed loop begins.

model_equations.noise_model: Gaussian residual proxy noise at SNR=6 plus low-amplitude channel offset noise; fixed across all models.
model_equations.synthetic_observation_vector: X_c = [E_c, Y_proxy_c, V_proxy_c] for each perturbation condition c
